pick_device.title: Choose a controller
pick_device.description: These controllers answered on your network. Enable Allow Local Commands on the one you pick (Controller > Settings > Advanced Settings) if you have not already.

discovery_confirm.title: Add {name}?
discovery_confirm.description: A Gemstone controller was found at {host}. Enable Allow Local Commands on it (Controller > Settings > Advanced Settings) if you have not already, then submit.

user.title: Connect to your Gemstone controller
user.description: No controller answered on your network, or yours is on another subnet. The controller announces itself every five minutes; to make it appear now, tap Control4 Identify in the Gemstone app (Device Settings > Advanced Settings) and try again. Or enable Allow Local Commands on it (Settings > Advanced Settings) and enter its IP address.

data_description.host: The controller's address on your network. Give it a DHCP reservation in your router so it does not change.
data_description.port: Leave at 80. Change it only if you reach the controller through a port-forward, or for the development simulator.

reconfigure.title: Update the controller's address
reconfigure.description: Enter the controller's new IP address.

data_description.port: Leave at 80 unless you reach the controller through a port-forward.

error.cannot_connect: Could not reach a controller at that address. Check the IP and that Allow Local Commands is enabled.
error.local_api_disabled: The controller is on the network but did not answer over HTTP. Turn on Allow Local Commands (Controller > Settings > Advanced Settings) and try again.
error.unknown: The controller answered in an unexpected way.

abort.already_in_progress: This controller is already being set up.
abort.not_gemstone: That device is not a Gemstone controller.
abort.wrong_device: The controller at that address is a different one. Add it as a new device instead of reconfiguring this one.

init.title: Polling
init.description: How often to check the controller when nothing is happening.

data_description.scan_interval: Seconds between checks of an idle controller. For a minute after any activity the integration polls every 5 seconds by itself.

play_pattern.name: Play pattern
play_pattern.description: Plays an animation with every parameter the controller accepts: up to 20 colours, speed, direction and a background colour.

colors.name: Colours
colors.description: One to twenty colours, each as [red, green, blue, warm white] with values 0-255.

speed.name: Speed
speed.description: 1-255. Defaults to the Animation speed entity.

direction.name: Direction
direction.description: Which way the animation travels. Only some animations move, and each accepts only some directions; anything else falls back to that animation's own default.

background_color.name: Background colour
background_color.description: [red, green, blue, warm white] shown behind the animation. Defaults to none.

name.name: Name
name.description: 1-32 characters; shown in the Gemstone app as what is playing. Defaults to the animation's name.

save_playing.name: Save the playing pattern
save_playing.description: Keeps the pattern the controller is playing, so it can be replayed from the Pattern control. Patterns made in the Gemstone app cannot be rebuilt by hand, and the controller cannot store them.

name.name: Name
name.description: What to call it. Defaults to the pattern's own name. Reusing a name replaces that pattern.

forget_pattern.name: Forget a saved pattern
forget_pattern.description: Drops a pattern this controller kept. The controller itself is not touched.

name.name: Name
name.description: The saved pattern to forget, as it appears in the Pattern control.

invalid_scene.message: The scene could not be built: {reason}

no_pattern_playing.message: There is no pattern playing to save. Start one in the Gemstone app or with the play pattern action.
